title: WPA2 Handshake & Hashcat Brute-Force
description: WPA2 tarmog'ini buzish: tarmoq kartasini monitoring rejimiga o'tkazish, handshake ushlash va Hashcat orqali parolni topish.

steps.instruction: wlan0 interfeysida monitor rejimini yoqish uchun airmon-ng utilitasidan foydalaning.
steps.output:
PHY	Interface	Driver		Chipset
phy0	wlan0		ath9k		Qualcomm Atheros

(mac80211 monitor mode vif enabled for [phy0]wlan0 on [phy0]wlan0mon)
(mac80211 station mode vif disabled for [phy0]wlan0)

💡 AI: Ajoyib! wlan0mon interfeysi hosil bo'ldi. Endi tarmoqni skanerlash uchun airodump-ng buyrug'ini ishga tushiring.

steps.instruction: Yangi yaratilgan wlan0mon interfeysida airodump-ng yordamida tarmoqni skanerlashni boshlang.
steps.output:

[+] WPA Handshake captured! Saved to 'handshake.hc22000'

💡 AI: Handshake ushlandi! Hozirgi katalogda fayl saqlanganini tekshirish uchun 'ls' buyrug'ini kiriting.

steps.instruction: Fayl saqlanganini tasdiqlash uchun katalog tarkibini ko'ring.
steps.output:
handshake.hc22000  wordlist.txt  quest_info.txt

💡 AI: handshake.hc22000 fayli joyida! Endi parolni lug'at (wordlist.txt) orqali buzish uchun Hashcat-ni ishga tushiring (WPA2 rejimi: -m 22000).

steps.instruction: Handshake faylini wordlist.txt yordamida брутфорс qilish uchun Hashcat-ni ishga tushiring.
